title: Rise + Flow | Yoga in the Orchard & Mini Market
description: Sunday morning yoga flow followed by coffee, seasonal treats, and local vendors.
long_description:
Sunday morning yoga flow followed by coffee, seasonal treats, and local vendors.

About this Event

Join us for a beautiful fall morning of movement, fresh air, coffee, local shopping, and community in the orchard.
We’ll begin the morning with a 60-minute, all-levels yoga flow from 10–11 AM, surrounded by the peaceful apple orchard and beautiful views of the surrounding fields. Whether you’re brand new to yoga or have an established practice, you’re welcome here — come exactly as you are.
After yoga, slow down and enjoy the rest of the morning. Grab a coffee from our visiting coffee truck, browse a curated selection of local vendors, and stay awhile to picnic, relax, and mingle with the community. There will be plenty of green space and benches to sit, enjoy your coffee, and take in the scenery.

✨ Your morning includes:🧘‍♀️ 60-minute all-levels yoga flow with beautiful countryside views☕ Coffee truck🛍️ Local vendors, pastries, & shopping🧺 Green space + benches for picnicking and relaxing🤍 Time to socialize and connect with the community

📍 Getting ThereThe yoga location is in the orchard across from the Round Barn.
Parking is available at Thirsty Farmer, followed by a short walk up the hill. If you'd prefer not to walk, a shuttle will be available to transport guests from the parking area to the top of the hill.
The event will take place outdoors, so please dress comfortably for the October weather and bring your yoga mat, water, and anything you'd like for your morning.

🌸 Event DetailsSunday, October 18
10:00 AM – 1:00 PM *Please arrive 15 minutes early to park and set up your mat
Across from the Historic Round Barn | Biglerville, PA
Come move your body, breathe in the fresh fall air, grab a coffee, shop local, and spend a slow Sunday morning surrounded by the apple trees. 🌾
All levels welcome.
